name: combo-box
title: Combo Box
description: A searchable multi-select combo box with compound components for full composability.

migration.guide: v3 modularizes into compound components (Root, SearchTrigger, Content, Item, ItemIcon, ItemIndicator, Empty, Tags). Use ComboBox.Composed for the same flat-props API as v2. For custom item rendering (checkbox + avatar + name), use the compound API with ComboBox.Item children. useComboBoxContext() is exported for advanced composition.

docs.lead: A searchable multi-select combo box with compound components. Use ComboBox.Composed for the simple flat-props API, or compose with Root, SearchTrigger, Content, Item, and Tags for full control over item rendering and tag display.

api.name: ComboBox.Root
api.description: Context provider and state orchestrator. Wraps all compound sub-components.

props.name: name
props.description: Form field name — renders hidden inputs for form submission.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Callback when dropdown open state changes.

api.name: ComboBox.SearchTrigger
api.description: Search input trigger with leading icon. Uses inputVariants for styling.

api.name: ComboBox.Content
api.description: Dropdown popover content with scroll area. When children are omitted, auto-renders items from filtered options.

props.name: emptyMessage
props.description: Message when no options match the search.

props.name: children
props.description: Custom content — overrides default item rendering.

api.name: ComboBox.Item
api.description: A single option row. When children are provided, renders custom content; otherwise renders icon + label from options.

props.name: value
props.description: The option value this item represents.

api.name: ComboBox.ItemIcon
api.description: Polymorphic icon for items. Supports React components and image URL strings.

api.name: ComboBox.ItemIndicator
api.description: Check indicator for selected items. Defaults to RiCheckLine.

api.name: ComboBox.Empty
api.description: Empty state content shown when no options match.

api.name: ComboBox.Tags
api.description: Tag display area for selected items. Omit entirely for custom tag rendering.

props.name: selectAllLabel
props.description: When provided and all options selected, show a single summary tag.

api.name: ComboBox.Composed
api.description: Convenience flat-props wrapper. Assembles Root + SearchTrigger + Content + Tags internally. Drop-in replacement for the v2 API.

props.name: selectAllLabel
props.description: Summary tag label when all selected.

api.name: useComboBoxContext
api.description: Hook to access ComboBox state from custom child components. Returns options, value, filteredOptions, isSelected, toggle, remove, removeAll, search, setSearch, open, disabled, and more.
